purpose: #1063 rc.80 final form: pair-level (query, doc, p_raw, gold) rows for the FiQA Jev rerank calibration gate

engine.source: main @ a179e1ef3 (release gate build, not rebuilt here)
engine.role: BM25 shortlists only (multi_match title+text, top-30) — deterministic arm, no embeddings exercised
engine.data_dir: mktemp -d under /tmp, discarded after the run

harness_validation_before_paid_calls.check: BM25 nDCG@10 over the regenerated top-30 shortlists, all 648 queries
harness_validation_before_paid_calls.note: bit-for-bit the 2026-09-20 baseline figure, which itself matched BEIR's published 0.236 for FiQA

provider.request_shape: identical to benchmarks/beir-hybrid/results/2026-09-20-rerank-full/raw_bench_full.py (one noul per shortlist doc, same instruction string, document = title + '. ' + text truncated to 1400 chars)
provider.key: TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment (never printed, never written)

files.pairs.jsonl: 19,440 raw rows: qid, docid, shortlist rank, p_raw (noul), gold (1 iff qrels score >= 1), graded qrels score
files.shortlists.json: qid -> ordered BM25 top-30 docids, the candidate set every probability is defined against
files.provider-calls.log: one line per paid call: qid, in/out tokens, wall seconds, answers count
files.stage1-summary.json: machine summary of the paid stage
files.gate.json: stage 2: split, fits, held-out ECE/Brier per arm, reliability curves, knots

determinism.engine_arm: BM25 shortlists deterministic (reproduced 0.2382 twice in this session, and identical to the 2026-09-20 run)
determinism.provider_arm: one repeat; the baseline measured per-doc probability drift mean |delta| 0.0148 / max 0.1 across its 3 repeats — a rerun of the paid stage will wobble within that band (this run's all-pairs raw ECE still landed on the published 0.3109)
determinism.gate_stage: pure computation on pairs.jsonl: sha256 split rule, no RNG, no clock (#940); reruns are bit-identical
